//! The `farewell` use case: the struct holding only the ports it calls.

use super::interface::FarewellUseCase;

/// `farewell`, over only the ports it calls, each an `Arc<dyn <Name>Port>` field the edge injects.
struct FarewellUseCaseImpl;

impl FarewellUseCaseImpl {
    /// `farewell` over the ports it calls, which the edge injects.
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl FarewellUseCase for FarewellUseCaseImpl {
    fn farewell(&self) {}
}
